name: Snow and ice morning: many calls, slow roads
intent: Snow cuts road speed to 0.6 of normal on top of rush hour. Fourteen calls in two hours. One ambulance is cleaning, one is too low on fuel to be offered, the helicopter is grounded and non-urgent trips move to private vans.
what_this_is: INPUT: what the world and the people do. No vehicle is assigned, no ETA, path or status is given: the model decides who goes, how long it takes and which way it drives. A stand-in dispatcher's decisions for the same input are in scenario/reference_runs/ for comparison.

clock.t_s: seconds since the script origin; the first model minute is t_s = 120

anchors.at_patient: the first crew (ambulance or doctor) reaches the patient
anchors.at_hospital: the patient arrives at the hospital

rules.voice_entry_timing: an entry happens offset_s seconds after its anchor. If the phase is shorter than the last offset, scale all offsets of that anchor so the last one falls inside 90 percent of the phase; keep their order.
rules.voice_entry_by: crew = the ambulance crew with the patient; doctor_if_on_scene = the doctor vehicle's crew if a doctor reached the patient before transport, otherwise the crew
rules.voice_states: an entry is 'heard' when said; confirmed by a crew tap or 'potrjeno' about 5 to 9 s later; an entry with needs_correction stays unconfirmed until the entry that 'corrects' it
rules.travel_hint: backend/app/routing.py constants (road factor 1.35, 42 km/h, lights and sirens x1.3, weather and traffic factors); the model may use real routing
rules.noise: monitor values may vary by a few units around the given numbers

fleet.reason: snow and low cloud at Brnik (assumed)
